description:
Implement a cross-question validation rule in the 'Household Financial Wellness 2025' survey. The survey collects 'Total Monthly Income' (Q_INCOME) and a breakdown of 'Monthly Expenses' (Q_EXPENSES). You must configure the 'Q_EXPENSES' question so that the sum of all expense sub-questions cannot exceed the reported income. 

Steps:
1. Log in to LimeSurvey (admin / Admin123!).
2. Open the 'Household Financial Wellness 2025' survey.
3. Edit the 'Q_EXPENSES' question.
4. In the 'Logic' settings (or General Options depending on theme), set the 'Question validation equation' to ensure sum(Q_EXPENSES) <= Q_INCOME.
5. Set the 'Question validation tip' to: 'Total expenses cannot exceed your reported income of {Q_INCOME}.' (You must dynamically reference the income variable).
